objects.doc: The root. `changed` reports every change anywhere in the model, for an extension that wants to see all of it; each delivery needs the grant of the member that changed.

methods.name: decide
methods.doc: Ask igni's local decision model (Laya) typed questions about a context, in one pass on this machine. `context` is named text fields — at most 8, 6,000 characters in all — that the questions quote in backticks; `questions` are 1–16 `DecisionQuestion`s. A context the model would have to cut is refused (`invalid`), never answered from part of it; a model that cannot be loaded answers `unavailable`. Zero-shot accuracy is modest: measure it on your own data before acting on an answer, and use the probabilities, not just the answer.

methods.name: decide_batch
methods.doc: `decide` for up to 16 contexts at once, sharing forward passes. One decision per context, in order.

objects.doc: The conversation in the current session. Signals carry the session they happened in, and arrive for every live session. `host.sessions.chat(id)` is the same object for any session of this project, without showing it: its properties read that session, and `post`, `queue`, `append` and `replace` write there (with `sessions.post` as well). A message posted there starts a run, or waits for the run already going there — never answering an approval. Its other methods act only on the session on screen.

methods.name: busy
methods.doc: Say this extension is working inside igni's process, so the process is not suspended under it (in the cloud, its VM). A lease for `reason`: it expires after `ttl_seconds` (default and at most 600) unless renewed by calling again with the same reason, so an extension that stops answering cannot keep igni awake. Shown in `app.activity`'s `busy`.

methods.name: done
methods.doc: Let go of the lease `busy` took for `reason`. Nothing happens if there is none.
